summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of new Event Journeys module (Marketing → Events). Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passed (event CRUD + validation, stakeholders external/internal, tasks + dependency enforcement + self-dep + date validation + delete-pull, task file upload/download/delete, budget items + totals, notifications trigger paths, marketing calendar journey expansion). Frontend: verified /events list (migrated 'Annual Product Launch 2026' shows 4 tasks / 25% progress / 3 overdue), New Event dialog with per-day time schedules + copy-times-to-all-days works, navigates to detail with 4 tabs (Overview/Stakeholders/Plan/Budget) and day-by-day schedule cards. Marketing Calendar: upcoming-events-strip shows amber 'IN 6 days' card + progress + navigates to detail, multi-day event card appears on every day (Day X/N) with times from day_schedules, 'New Event' button opens create dialog on /events. Marketing Masters correctly has only 3 tabs (Categories, Platforms, Event Types) — Custom Events tab removed. Marketing module sidebar contains an 'Events' nav item.
critical_code_review_comments: event_journeys.py update_task: on status transition uses merged.depends_on = new depends_on (fine), but if depends_on itself references tasks whose completion changed since fetch there is no race protection — acceptable for MVP.
_generate_reminders is O(tasks) per GET; may be worth caching once event has many tasks, but currently deduped via db lookup per task.
MarketingCalendar 'New Event' navigates to /events?new=1 which is auto-cleared on mount (setSearchParams({}, {replace:true})). Works as intended; noted.
Task file storage uses filesystem — ensure /app/backend/uploads/event_tasks is persisted across deploys (should be a mounted volume).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_event_journeys.py — reuse for regression. All /api/events endpoints, dependency guard, file upload, budget totals, and marketing calendar expansion are covered. Frontend flow verified end-to-end on public URL with fresh event creation + cleanup. Data-testids in Events.js/EventDetail.js/MarketingCalendar.js all resolve. No open issues.
